title: Compare complete OBJ parser and texture helper states in real browser Wasm
scope: Safe input-only OBJ/helper codecs and exact current-SHA original/native/Chrome comparisons; preserve all existing 341 browser cases and explicitly retain two new large native-only OBJ progress workloads.
acceptance: Actual Chrome executes authored input packets through complete Rust parser/helpers; every geometry/color/note/progress/refusal/output byte matches independent original/native results.
All old browser cases/budgets retained; v2 historical proof stays immutable and cannot satisfy the new v3 runtime roster.
Bounded typed packet decoding, distinct host failures, mutation/shape/failure-retention tests and full actual raw evidence.
open_items: Three explicit native-only workloads remain above unchanged private ABI caps: PLY vertex progress and both OBJ million-line progress fixtures. None counts as a browser pass.
Image-file decoding/bundling, public commands/session/history/projects/UI, broader runtime platforms and generic P36/P37/P39 remain open. No numerical unit is accepted.
resolved_items: 2026-11-02: actual Chrome passes all 564 independent source/native/Wasm cases: 482 complete outputs/helper states and 82 source refusals. All old 341 cases and budgets retained.
All 144 helper and 79 parser browser states match exactly, including full float32/color bytes, ordered texture notes and progress/refusals. Two full-size OBJ workloads remain native-only.
18 bounded protocol checks pass; zero module imports/page errors. Complete hashed raw proof replays independently; historical v2 proof remains immutable and cannot satisfy live v3.
